description_en: Cancels a call task. If detail records have entered the pending call queue or are currently being called, they cannot be canceled
description_zh: 呼叫任务取消呼叫，如明细记录已经进入待呼队列或者正在呼叫，则无法取消
name: CancelAiCallDetails

parameters.help_en: The task ID. You can view the task ID on the Call task management page or obtain the task ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926799.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。在呼叫任务管理界面查看任务ID或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926799.html接口获取任务ID
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The list of task detail IDs. If this parameter is specified, it takes precedence, and the BatchId and PhoneNumbers parameters are invalid
parameters.help_zh: 任务明细ID列表，如果指定了该参数，则以该参数为准，BatchId和PhoneNumbers无效
parameters.name: detail_id_list

parameters.help_en: The batch ID. This is the batch ID returned when callee data is imported. You can view the batch ID on the Call task management > Details > Execution records page, or use the batch ID returned when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926815.html operation to import callee data. If the DetailIdList parameter is specified, this parameter is invalid
parameters.help_zh: 批次ID。即为导入被叫数据时返回的批次ID，在呼叫任务管理>详情>执行记录界面查看任务批次ID或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926815.html接口导入被叫数据时返回的导入批次ID，如果指定了DetailIdList，则该参数无效
parameters.name: batch_id

parameters.help_en: The list of phone numbers. To use this parameter, you must specify the BatchId parameter. Otherwise, this parameter is considered invalid
parameters.help_zh: 手机号列表，如果需要使用该参数，则必须指定BatchId，否则认为参数无效
parameters.name: phone_numbers

parameters.help_en:
The encryption method. Valid values:
0: No encryption.
1: MD5.
2: SHA256.
3: SM3
parameters.name: encryption_type

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝的详细原因

FailedDetails.description_en: The details of failed cancellations. This parameter is a map where the key is the ID or phone number of the failed detail record, and the value is the reason for the failure
FailedDetails.description_zh: 失败明细情况。是个Map，Key为失败的明细ID或者手机号码，Value为失败原因

ResultCode.description_en:
The cancellation result. Valid values:
ALL_FAILED: All cancellations failed.
ALL_SUCCEED: All cancellations succeeded.
PART_FAILED: Some cancellations failed
ResultCode.description_zh:
取消结果。取值：
ALL_FAILED：全部取消失败。
ALL_SUCCEED：全部取消成功。
PART_FAILED：部分取消失败

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was called successfully. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
